facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: fire on P-4105 during commissioning of replacement equipment

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip on P-4105 and PT-4105 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-4105 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 15 June 2015 an incident occurred on P-4105 and PT-4105 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment, releasing pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator.
